title: Logo misuse

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Show concrete violations so partners can recognize when an alteration changes or confuses the identity.
strategic_value: Explicit rejection examples can protect the continuity of IBM’s mark across independently produced materials.
demonstration: Four red-crossed specimens show extra color, mingling with a partner logo, incorrect recoloring of reversed artwork and a relationship statement inside clear space.
practical_value: Reject modified or crowded artwork before it enters a partner layout.

content_islands.name: Purpose note
content_islands.spec: Explain at left why alterations diminish the brand.

content_islands.name: Color and combination errors
content_islands.spec: Use the top row for additional color and mingled partner/IBM marks.

content_islands.name: Artwork and spacing errors
content_islands.spec: Use the bottom row for reversed-to-black recoloring and a tagline intruding into logo clear space.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that alterations and combinations misrepresent and diminish the IBM brand.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The examples prohibit additional logo colors, mingling logos, recoloring reversed-white artwork black and putting taglines within clear space.
